# Background

## Learning Locomotion with Musculoskeletal Models

- Cover the standard approaches for learning locomotion on msms
- namely, tracking a pre-recorded reference by having a policy output muscle activiatiosn
- this is bad because kinematically feasible != muscle feasible (i.e. there could be conflicting activiations within the same muscle group)
